fullDescription: Confident color-block SaaS landing built from full-bleed bands (white to paper gray to ONE loud cobalt to dark ink), Space Grotesk tight-tracked headlines over Inter body, anchored by a saturated cobalt CTA band with dot-grain texture, soft white and deeper-cobalt glows, and a white drop-shadow pill button.

structured.summary: A full-bleed color-block landing page whose star is one saturated cobalt CTA band. It reads as a real page top to bottom: a glass blurred sticky nav (logo tile + 4 links + 'Start free' pill), a centered white intro section (a live-dot 'X prompts and counting' pill, a huge tight-tracked grotesk headline, a muted subhead, and a 3-item check-mark trust row), a full-bleed light-gray supporting strip with a 4-up stat grid, then the anchor: an edge-to-edge solid cobalt #1f4fff CTA band with a faint dot-grain texture and soft white/deeper-cobalt radial glows, holding an uppercase glass eyebrow pill, a giant white payoff headline, a white/85 subhead, a dual button row (a white pill primary with a heavy navy drop shadow beside a glass-outline secondary), and a small trust line. It closes on a full-bleed dark-ink #0a1230 footer with a 3-column link grid and a legal bar. The whole design is built from hard full-bleed color blocks (white -> light gray -> cobalt -> dark ink) seamed by 1px hairlines.

style.description: A confident, modern color-block SaaS aesthetic where full-bleed bands of solid color do the work instead of cards or gradients-everywhere. The palette is disciplined: white and a near-black cobalt-ink #0a1230 for text/footer, a light paper gray #f6f7fb for the supporting strip, and ONE loud saturated cobalt #1f4fff (with #1a43e0 / #1536bd shades) that owns the hero accents and the entire star CTA band. Hierarchy comes from band background swaps and ink-opacity steps (cobalt-ink at /70 /60 /55 /50, white at /90 /85 /45 /40) rather than many hues. Two fonts split the labor: Space Grotesk at 700 with very tight tracking (-0.05em on display) for all headlines and stat numbers, and Inter for body and nav. The cobalt band gets tasteful depth without going soft: a 1px white/25 seam highlight across its top edge, a radial dot grain overlay, a big white/15 blurred glow blooming from top center, and two deeper-cobalt blurred glows pooling at the bottom corners. Buttons feel physical: the white primary carries a large navy-tinted drop shadow and lifts 2px on hover; pills and outlines use white-alpha. The mood is energetic and product-forward, an infinite-canvas design tool selling 'one prompt to shippable UI', loud where it counts (the cobalt band) and calm everywhere else.
style.prompt: Build a confident color-block SaaS landing whose anchor is a single full-bleed cobalt CTA band. Palette is white + ink + ONE cobalt: white #ffffff (page bg), cobalt-ink #0a1230 (all dark text and the footer field), paper #f6f7fb (the supporting strip band), and cobalt #1f4fff as the one loud accent with shades cobalt-600 #1a43e0 and cobalt-700 #1536bd. Drive hierarchy from band background swaps (white -> paper -> cobalt -> ink, seamed by 1px black/5 or white/alpha hairlines) plus opacity steps: dark text uses text-cobalt-ink at /70 /60 /55 /50, the cobalt band uses white at /90 /85, the footer uses white at /70 /45 /40. Two Google fonts: Space Grotesk (400-700) as the display/grotesk family for every headline and stat number, set font-700 with tight tracking (a .tight = -0.035em and a .tighter = -0.05em utility) and very short leading (0.95-0.98); Inter (400-600) as the body/sans for subheads, nav links, trust rows, footer. Headlines use clamp() sizing (hero clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.25rem); CTA clamp(2.6rem,7vw,5rem)). The STAR is a full-bleed solid cobalt section (bg-cobalt, w-full, overflow-hidden) with layered SOFT depth that never turns the block muddy: (a) a 1px top seam highlight = absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-white/25; (b) a dot-grain overlay = radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(255,255,255,0.10) 1px, transparent 0) at 22px 22px, ~60% opacity; (c) a top-center bloom = a 34rem white/15 circle blurred 120px translated up off the top edge; (d) two bottom-corner pools = a 34rem cobalt-700/60 circle blur-3xl bottom-right and a 26rem cobalt-600/50 circle blur-3xl bottom-left. Buttons are physical: the white primary pill (bg-white text-cobalt rounded-full, ring-1 ring-white/40) carries box-shadow 0 18px 40px -12px rgba(8,18,60,0.55), deepening on hover, and every .btn-press lifts translateY(-2px) on hover. Eyebrows are small uppercase pills with wide tracking (0.18em) on white/10 glass with white/25 borders; the hero pill instead uses cobalt/5 fill + cobalt/20 border + a live ping dot. The nav is glass: bg-white/80 + backdrop-blur-xl + a black/5 bottom border. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph) used sparingly. Antialiased, smooth-scroll. Keep it loud only in the cobalt band, calm and white-spacious everywhere else; no second bright hue, no em-dashes in copy.
style.prompt_short: Confident color-block SaaS landing: full-bleed bands (white -> paper gray -> ONE loud cobalt -> dark ink) seamed by hairlines, Space Grotesk tight-tracked headlines over Inter body, and a saturated cobalt CTA band with a dot-grain texture, soft white/deeper-cobalt glows, and a white drop-shadow pill button.

layout_and_structure.description: A real framed landing page read as a vertical stack of full-bleed color blocks: a glass sticky nav, a centered white intro section (so the CTA has context above it), a full-bleed paper-gray supporting strip carrying a 4-up stat grid, then the anchor full-bleed cobalt CTA band, then a full-bleed dark-ink footer. Centered content lives in a mx-auto max-w-6xl column with px-6 gutters (the CTA band narrows its content to max-w-5xl, headline/subhead copy to max-w-4xl / max-w-xl). It reflows cleanly to one column on mobile: nav center links hide behind the logo + 'Start free', the trust rows wrap, the stat grid goes 2-col, the dual buttons stack full-width, and the footer link grid collapses 3-col -> 2-col.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50 w-full) with a thin bottom border (border-b border-black/5) and a glass fill (bg-white/80 + backdrop-blur-xl). Inside a mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-6xl items-center justify-between px-6 row: LEFT = a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-lg cobalt tile (bg-cobalt text-white, grid place-items-center) holding a ph:bounding-box-bold icon (19px), beside an 18px (text-lg) Space Grotesk font-700 .tight 'Promptframe' wordmark; CENTER (hidden, md:flex, gap-8) = four 15px font-500 cobalt-ink/70 links 'Library / Canvas / Skill / Pricing' that brighten to full cobalt-ink on hover (.nav-link transition); RIGHT = a 15px font-500 cobalt-ink/70 'Log in' text link (hidden on smallest screens, sm:block) and a rounded-full cobalt 'Start free' pill (bg-cobalt px-5 py-2 text-white font-600, .btn-press, hover:bg-cobalt-600) linking to #cta.

A centered intro on white: mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6, pt-20->28 pb-16->24, text-center. Top: a mx-auto inline-flex rounded-full pill (border-cobalt/20, bg-cobalt/5, px-4 py-1.5, 13px font-600 text-cobalt) containing a live ping dot (a relative h-2 w-2 with an absolute animate-ping cobalt circle at opacity-60 behind a solid cobalt dot) and the label 'X,X00 prompts and counting'. Then a mx-auto mt-7 max-w-4xl Space Grotesk h1 (font-700, .tighter -0.05em tracking, leading-[0.98], size clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.25rem)) 'Design the interface before you write a single line.' Then a mx-auto mt-6 max-w-xl subhead (Inter, leading-relaxed, text-cobalt-ink/60, size clamp(1.05rem,2vw,1.2rem)): 'Promptframe turns a sentence into shippable UI on an infinite canvas. Browse the library, fork a prompt, hand it to your coding agent.' Then a mt-9 flex-wrap centered trust row (gap-x-8 gap-y-4, 14px font-500 text-cobalt-ink/50) of three items, each an inline-flex with an 18px cobalt ph:check-circle-fill icon: 'No credit card', 'Works in Claude Code & Cursor', 'Export to code'.

prompts.partPt: Full-bleed paper supporting strip (4-up Números e Resultados)
prompts.prompt: A full-bleed light band: section w-full with border-y border-black/5 and bg-paper #f6f7fb. Inside a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-14: a grid that is 2-col on mobile and 4-col on sm (gap-px), each cell px-3 text-center. Each stat is a Space Grotesk number (text-3xl sm:text-4xl, font-700, .tight, text-cobalt) over a mt-1 13px font-500 caption (text-cobalt-ink/55). Cells: '5 sec' / 'prompt -> first mockup'; '57k' / 'designers shipping'; '40+' / 'use-case categories'; the infinity glyph / 'canvas, zero limits'.

prompts.prompt: The anchor section (id='cta') as a full-bleed solid cobalt block: relative w-full overflow-hidden bg-cobalt. Layer depth absolutely behind the content: (1) a 1px top seam highlight (absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-white/25); (2) a .grain dot overlay (absolute inset-0, radial-gradient dot pattern, opacity-60); (3) a top-center white bloom (absolute left-1/2 top-[-18%] h-[34rem] w-[34rem] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-white/15 blur-[120px]); (4) a bottom-right pool (absolute -bottom-56 -right-40 h-[34rem] w-[34rem] rounded-full bg-cobalt-700/60 blur-3xl); (5) a bottom-left pool (absolute -bottom-48 -left-40 h-[26rem] w-[26rem] rounded-full bg-cobalt-600/50 blur-3xl). Content sits in a relative mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 py-28 sm:py-36 text-center column.

prompts.prompt: Inside the cobalt band, centered: an inline-flex glass eyebrow pill (rounded-full, border-white/25, bg-white/10, px-4 py-1.5, 13px font-600 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.18em, text-white/90) with a ph:sparkle-fill icon (14px) and 'Start designing'. Then a mx-auto mt-8 max-w-4xl Space Grotesk h2 (font-700, .tighter, leading-[0.95], white, size clamp(2.6rem,7vw,5rem)) 'Your next UI is one prompt away.' Then a mx-auto mt-7 max-w-xl subhead (Inter, leading-relaxed, text-white/85, size clamp(1.1rem,2.2vw,1.35rem)): 'Open the canvas, describe what you want, and watch the screens build themselves. Free to start, no setup.'

A mt-11 row that is flex-col items-center on mobile and sm:flex-row (gap-4), centered. PRIMARY = a white pill 'Start designing free': group inline-flex items-center gap-2, rounded-full, bg-white, px-9 py-4, Space Grotesk text-cobalt font-600 (~1.05rem), ring-1 ring-white/40, box-shadow 0 18px 40px -12px rgba(8,18,60,0.55) deepening to 0 24px 50px -12px rgba(8,18,60,0.7) on hover, .btn-press lift, with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold (18px) that translate-x-1 on group-hover. SECONDARY = a glass-outline pill 'Browse the library': rounded-full, border-white/30, px-7 py-4, text-white/90 font-500 (~1.05rem), .nav-link, hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white. Below, a mt-7 centered 13.5px font-500 text-white/90 trust line: 'Trusted by indie hackers, PMs and design teams shipping every day.'

A full-bleed footer: w-full bg-cobalt-ink #0a1230 text-white. Inside mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-16: a top row that is flex-col on mobile / sm:flex-row, justify-between gap-12. LEFT (max-w-xs) = the cobalt logo tile + 'Promptframe' wordmark (repeated from nav) over a mt-4 14px leading-relaxed text-white/45 blurb 'Idea to shippable UI, on an infinite canvas. Built for builders.' RIGHT = a 3-column link grid (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3, gap-x-14 gap-y-8): each column has a 13px font-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-white/40 heading ('Product' / 'Company' / 'Connect') over a mt-4 space-y-3 14px text-white/70 link list (Canvas/Library/Skill; About/Pricing/Changelog; X / Twitter/Discord/Contact) that brighten to white on hover. Then a mt-14 border-t border-white/10 pt-8 legal bar (flex-col items-start / sm:flex-row sm:items-center, justify-between gap-4, 13px text-white/40): a copyright string left and 'Privacy' + 'Terms' links right.

special_ui_components.prompt: Compose the page from edge-to-edge solid-color bands instead of contained cards: a white intro, a paper-gray #f6f7fb supporting strip (border-y border-black/5), the loud solid cobalt #1f4fff CTA band, and a dark-ink #0a1230 footer, each a w-full section seamed to the next by a 1px hairline (border-black/5 on light, white/25 highlight atop the cobalt band). Content within each band is re-centered in a mx-auto max-w-6xl/5xl px-6 column. The color swap itself is the section divider and the visual rhythm; the loud cobalt is rationed to exactly one band so it lands as the climax.

The star section is a single saturated cobalt block kept from going flat or muddy by FIVE soft absolute layers behind the content: a 1px white/25 top seam highlight (so the band reads as a crisp color block, not a fade), a radial dot-grain overlay (radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(255,255,255,0.10) 1px, transparent 0) / 22px 22px at opacity-60) for fine texture, a large white/15 circle blurred 120px blooming from just above top-center, and two deeper-cobalt pools at the bottom corners (cobalt-700/60 bottom-right, cobalt-600/50 bottom-left, both blur-3xl). overflow-hidden clips the glows; all layers are pointer-events-none so they never block the buttons.

The primary CTA is a white pill on the cobalt field that reads as a lifted physical object: bg-white, text-cobalt, rounded-full, ring-1 ring-white/40, with a large navy-tinted drop shadow box-shadow 0 18px 40px -12px rgba(8,18,60,0.55) that deepens to 0 24px 50px -12px rgba(8,18,60,0.7) on hover. A shared .btn-press utility (transition transform .15s, box-shadow .15s) lifts it translateY(-2px) on hover, and its trailing ph:arrow-right-bold nudges translate-x-1 on group-hover. Pair it with a quiet glass-outline secondary (border-white/30, transparent fill -> hover bg-white/10) so only one button feels solid.

Small rounded-full eyebrow pills label each section. On the cobalt band: a glass variant = border-white/25, bg-white/10, 13px font-600 UPPERCASE with letter-spacing 0.18em, text-white/90, a leading ph:sparkle-fill icon. In the white intro: a live variant = border-cobalt/20, bg-cobalt/5, 13px font-600 text-cobalt with a ping dot (a stacked relative h-2 w-2: an absolute animate-ping cobalt circle at opacity-60 behind a solid cobalt dot) signalling a live count.

A translucent sticky header (sticky top-0 z-50) with bg-white/80 + backdrop-blur-xl and a border-b border-black/5, so page content shows softly through it on scroll. Center links and the 'Log in' link use a shared .nav-link transition (color .15s) going from text-cobalt-ink/70 to full cobalt-ink on hover; the brand mark is a cobalt rounded-lg icon tile + a Space Grotesk wordmark; the right side ends in a solid cobalt 'Start free' pill that anchors to #cta.

Four headline metrics on the paper-gray band: a grid (2-col mobile, 4-col sm, gap-px so the paper shows as faint seams) of px-3 text-center cells, each a big Space Grotesk cobalt number (text-3xl sm:text-4xl, font-700, .tight) over a 13px font-500 cobalt-ink/55 caption. The numbers mix units and a glyph ('5 sec', '57k', '40+', infinity) to read as a quick capabilities scoreboard rather than dense data.

structured.special_notes: Palette is white + ink + ONE cobalt only: white #ffffff (page), cobalt-ink #0a1230 (dark text + footer field), paper #f6f7fb (supporting strip band), cobalt #1f4fff (the single loud accent) with shades cobalt-600 #1a43e0 and cobalt-700 #1536bd (used for the hover state and the deeper-cobalt bottom glows). No second bright hue is introduced; hierarchy is band-swap + opacity steps (dark text at cobalt-ink full/70/60/55/50; white at /90/85/45/40). Two Google fonts: Space Grotesk (400-700) for ALL headlines + stat numbers (font-700, .tight -0.035em and .tighter -0.05em tracking, leading 0.95-0.98, clamp() sizes), Inter (400-600) for body/nav/trust/footer. Icons are Iconify Phosphor: ph:bounding-box-bold (logo), ph:check-circle-fill (trust row), ph:sparkle-fill (CTA eyebrow), ph:arrow-right-bold (primary button). The signature language is full-bleed solid color blocks (white -> paper -> cobalt -> ink) seamed by 1px hairlines, with the loud cobalt band rationed to one climactic section that gets soft depth from a top seam highlight + dot grain + a white top bloom + two deeper-cobalt corner pools, plus a white drop-shadow pill button. To transfer the STYLE: keep white + ink + ONE loud cobalt, the two-font split (Space Grotesk tight display over Inter body), the band-swap hierarchy, and the soft-but-not-muddy depth on the single saturated block. To transfer the LAYOUT: keep the framed stack (glass sticky nav -> centered white intro with pill + huge headline + check trust row -> paper 4-up stat strip -> full-bleed cobalt CTA band: eyebrow -> payoff headline -> subhead -> white-pill + glass-outline dual buttons -> trust line -> dark-ink 3-column footer). All copy avoids em-dashes.
